cim: How to use AI to simplify your holiday shopping
cim_eredeti: How to use AI to simplify your holiday shopping
szoveg_eredeti:
Holiday shopping can bring a flurry of questions: What do you buy the person who has everything? Which of three similar products should you choose? Where are the best prices? And how will you get it all done on time?

Here are five ways that artificial intelligence (AI) can help:

Don’t simply ask an AI chatbot, “What should I get my uncle?” News alert: AI doesn’t know him. The more specific your prompt, the better the response says Manjeet Rege, professor and director of the Center for Applied Artificial Intelligence at the University of St. Thomas in Minnesota.

Tell AI something like, “My 72-year-old uncle has these hobbies. This year I want to introduce him to something new,” says Rege. “It could be a little bit of prompt engineering.”

Another example would be, “My 28-year-old sister loves traveling, cooking and live music. She lives in a small apartment and doesn’t want more clutter. Give me 10 gift ideas between $25 and $75, including experiences.”

Instead of setting a price for each gift, give AI your entire shopping budget. Tell it whom you’re buying for, how much you can spend overall, and which recipients are priorities. Ask it to allocate the money and suggest several gifts at each price point. Include estimated taxes and shipping, so a $500 budget doesn’t become $600 at checkout.

Once you’ve narrowed the choices to two or three products, ask AI to compare the features that matter to you. Specify your priorities, whether that’s durability, ease of use or value, and request a simple comparison table with pros and cons.

A retailer-specific AI tool, found in many national stores, will steer shoppers toward merchandise that retailers sell, Rege says. A general AI tool may provide a direct link to a retailer, but don’t assume it found the lowest price. “It will not tell you that there is a cheaper item elsewhere,” he says.

Once you’ve decided on a particular gift, ask AI where else it’s sold and compare prices.

After you have rounded up all the information, give AI your shopping list and ask it to organize purchases by retailer, price, shipping deadline and even the person you’re buying for.

Whatever AI tool you use, verify prices, products, sellers, shipping dates and return policies before you buy.
